Simple to assemble and convenient to move around. It works well for sorting various workshop supplies.
Well-made and practical, simple to put together and convenient for daily use. Highly recommend this storage unit.

We live in Wisconsin and I wanted to be able to keep out patio furniture free of the winter snow and ice. It has been on our gazebo for several months now and it works perfectly. Hubby said it actually wasn't too bad to install either. I am really glad we bought this.
Responsiveness is instant, every command is executed immediately. No time wasted during daily use.
Amazing product! Easy to assemble. It really came together, thank you!

Bought it last month. My 12 y/o grand son (who is a LEGO EXPERT) put together the entire frame with me (grandpa) assisting. He followed the pictures in the instructions. He said “ PAPA THIS JUST LIKE A LEGO KIT”!!!! All I did was hold the pipes in position while he made the connections. It was easy for a 12 y/o so it should be easy for anyone. We did watch a YouTube video but Harper James was the lead builder.!!!!!! It was a 12’ X 20’ carport. I am redoing the garage and I needed a rain proof shelter to move my garage contents while shelving and cabinets are installed.

Tuote tuli 2vkoa sitten. Ostin tämän 6m pituisen veneen talliksi. Oli kuin tehty sille. Hieman hankaluuksia kehikon siirtämisessä kun on painoa aika paljon (lapsen kanssa pystytettiin). Muutoin aivan loistava tuote. Helppo kasata. Katsotaan miten toimii talven yli.
